purpose: Expose FFBBP 1.7 typed assurance semantics to RHRC while preserving the independently qualified RUN42C executable lineage and refusing to infer RUN46F runtime authority from the paper alone.

source.title: FFBBP: A Reference Framework for Latent-Field Inference and Typed Assurance

runtime_authority.reason: FFBBP 1.7 implementation/release bytes were not imported into RHRC in this migration.

imported_semantics: snapshot decision sufficiency is separate from stateful transition closure
NOT_APPLICABLE cannot be used as a post-hoc waiver of a required gate
profile, protocol and execution identities are distinct qualification objects
diagnostic agreement does not imply categorical decision preservation
local witness separation does not imply unmasked full-system separation
material claim-bearing changes require new evidence or a separately justified equivalence result
forbidden_promotions: local witness -> full-system separation without masking clearance
